name: 106C - Core - Execute Routed Tool - Final V2

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS session_id,
        $2::BIGINT AS message_id
),

execution_context AS (
    SELECT
        session.id AS session_id,
        session.clinic_id,
        session.patient_id,
        session.status AS session_status,
        session.pending_action,

        clinic.name AS clinic_name,

        message.id AS message_id,
        message.tool_action,
        message.tool_result,

        message.tool_result -> 'safety'
            AS safety_payload,

        message.tool_result -> 'routing'
            AS routing_payload

    FROM request_data request

    INNER JOIN conversation_sessions session
        ON session.id = request.session_id

    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.id = session.clinic_id

    INNER JOIN conversation_messages message
        ON message.id = request.message_id
       AND message.session_id = session.id
       AND message.direction = 'inbound'

    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM execution_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM execution_context
            WHERE routing_payload IS NULL
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM execution_context
            WHERE routing_payload ->> 'route_status' <> 'ready'
               OR COALESCE(
                    (routing_payload ->> 'payload_ready')::BOOLEAN,
                    FALSE
                  ) = FALSE
        )
            THEN FALSE

        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM execution_context
        )
            THEN 'message_or_session_not_found'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM execution_context
            WHERE routing_payload IS NULL
        )
            THEN 'tool_route_not_found'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM execution_context
            WHERE routing_payload ->> 'route_status' <> 'ready'
               OR COALESCE(
                    (routing_payload ->> 'payload_ready')::BOOLEAN,
                    FALSE
                  ) = FALSE
        )
            THEN 'tool_route_not_ready'

        ELSE 'tool_execution_context_loaded'
    END AS result,

    (
        SELECT ROW_TO_JSON(execution_context)
        FROM execution_context
    ) AS execution_context

FROM request_data request;

WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS clinic_id,
        $2::BIGINT AS session_id,
        $3::BIGINT AS message_id,
        $4::TEXT AS tool_action,
        NULLIF($5::INTEGER, 0) AS target_workflow_number,
        NULLIF($6::TEXT, '') AS target_workflow_name,
        $7::TEXT AS endpoint,
        $8::TEXT AS http_method,
        $9::JSONB AS request_payload,
        $10::BOOLEAN AS allow_retry,
        $11::INTEGER AS max_retry_attempts
),

key_data AS (
    SELECT
        request.*,

        MD5(
            request.session_id::TEXT
            || ':'
            || request.message_id::TEXT
            || ':'
            || request.tool_action
            || ':'
            || request.endpoint
            || ':'
            || request.request_payload::TEXT
        ) AS idempotency_key

    FROM request_data request
),

inserted_log AS (
    INSERT INTO tool_execution_logs (
        clinic_id,
        session_id,
        input_message_id,
        tool_action,
        target_workflow_number,
        target_workflow_name,
        endpoint,
        http_method,
        request_payload,
        status,
        idempotency_key,
        attempt_count,
        started_at
    )

    SELECT
        key.clinic_id,
        key.session_id,
        key.message_id,
        key.tool_action,
        key.target_workflow_number,
        key.target_workflow_name,
        key.endpoint,
        key.http_method,
        key.request_payload,
        'running',
        key.idempotency_key,
        1,
        NOW()

    FROM key_data key

    ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key)
    DO NOTHING

    RETURNING *
),

retried_log AS (
    UPDATE tool_execution_logs log

    SET
        status = 'running',
        attempt_count = log.attempt_count + 1,
        started_at = NOW(),
        completed_at = NULL,
        duration_ms = NULL,
        http_status = NULL,
        response_payload = NULL,
        error_type = NULL,
        error_message = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM key_data key

    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inserted_log
          )

      AND key.allow_retry = TRUE
      AND log.idempotency_key = key.idempotency_key
      AND log.status = 'failed'
      AND log.attempt_count < key.max_retry_attempts

    RETURNING log.*
),

executable_log AS (
    SELECT * FROM inserted_log
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM retried_log
),

existing_log AS (
    SELECT log.*
    FROM tool_execution_logs log

    INNER JOIN key_data key
        ON key.idempotency_key =
           log.idempotency_key

    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM executable_log
    )

    LIMIT 1
),

selected_log AS (
    SELECT
        executable.*,
        TRUE AS should_execute
    FROM executable_log executable

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        existing.*,
        FALSE AS should_execute
    FROM existing_log existing
)

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM executable_log
        )
            THEN 'tool_execution_reserved'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM existing_log
            WHERE status = 'succeeded'
        )
            THEN 'tool_execution_already_succeeded'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM existing_log
            WHERE status = 'running'
        )
            THEN 'tool_execution_already_running'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM existing_log
            WHERE status = 'failed'
        )
            THEN 'tool_execution_retry_required'

        ELSE 'tool_execution_not_reserved'
    END AS result,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM selected_log
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS execution_log_id,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT should_execute
            FROM selected_log
            LIMIT 1
        ),
        FALSE
    ) AS should_execute,

    (
        SELECT status
        FROM selected_log
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS execution_status,

    (
        SELECT attempt_count
        FROM selected_log
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS attempt_count,

    (
        SELECT response_payload
        FROM selected_log
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS existing_response_payload,

    (
        SELECT max_retry_attempts
        FROM request_data
    ) AS max_retry_attempts,

    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM existing_log
            WHERE status = 'failed'
              AND attempt_count >= (
                    SELECT max_retry_attempts
                    FROM request_data
                  )
        )
            THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS retry_limit_reached

FROM request_data request;

WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS execution_log_id,
        $2::BIGINT AS session_id,
        $3::BIGINT AS message_id,
        $4::BOOLEAN AS execution_success,
        $5::TEXT AS tool_action,
        NULLIF($6::INTEGER, 0) AS target_workflow_number,
        NULLIF($7::TEXT, '') AS target_workflow_name,
        NULLIF($8::INTEGER, 0) AS http_status,
        $9::JSONB AS response_payload,
        NULLIF($10::TEXT, '') AS error_type,
        NULLIF($11::TEXT, '') AS error_message,
        $12::INTEGER AS duration_ms
),

updated_log AS (
    UPDATE tool_execution_logs log

    SET
        status = CASE
            WHEN request.execution_success = TRUE
                THEN 'succeeded'
            ELSE 'failed'
        END,

        completed_at = NOW(),
        duration_ms = request.duration_ms,
        http_status = request.http_status,
        response_payload = request.response_payload,
        error_type = request.error_type,
        error_message = request.error_message,
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM request_data request

    WHERE log.id = request.execution_log_id

    RETURNING log.*
),

updated_message AS (
    UPDATE conversation_messages message

    SET
        tool_result =
            COALESCE(
                message.tool_result,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                'execution',
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'execution_log_id',
                        request.execution_log_id,

                    'success',
                        request.execution_success,

                    'tool_action',
                        request.tool_action,

                    'target_workflow_number',
                        request.target_workflow_number,

                    'target_workflow_name',
                        request.target_workflow_name,

                    'http_status',
                        request.http_status,

                    'response',
                        request.response_payload,

                    'error_type',
                        request.error_type,

                    'error_message',
                        request.error_message,

                    'duration_ms',
                        request.duration_ms,

                    'completed_at',
                        NOW()
                )
            )

    FROM request_data request

    WHERE message.id = request.message_id
      AND message.session_id = request.session_id

    RETURNING message.id
),

updated_session AS (
    UPDATE conversation_sessions session

    SET
        status = CASE
            WHEN request.execution_success = TRUE
                THEN 'active'
            ELSE 'waiting_human'
        END,

        pending_action = CASE
            WHEN request.execution_success = TRUE
                THEN NULL
            ELSE request.tool_action
        END,

        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM request_data request

    WHERE session.id = request.session_id

      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM updated_message
      )

    RETURNING
        session.status,
        session.pending_action
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_log
        )
            THEN FALSE
        ELSE request.execution_success
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_log
        )
            THEN 'execution_log_not_found'

        WHEN request.execution_success = TRUE
            THEN 'tool_execution_completed'

        ELSE 'tool_execution_failed'
    END AS result,

    request.execution_log_id,
    request.session_id,
    request.message_id,
    request.tool_action,
    request.target_workflow_number,
    request.target_workflow_name,
    request.http_status,
    request.response_payload,
    request.error_type,
    request.error_message,
    request.duration_ms,

    (
        SELECT status
        FROM updated_session
    ) AS session_status,

    (
        SELECT pending_action
        FROM updated_session
    ) AS pending_action,

    CASE
        WHEN request.execution_success = TRUE
            THEN 'compose_response'
        ELSE 'compose_error_response'
    END AS next_action

FROM request_data request;

parameters.jsCode:
const reservation = $json;
const request = $('Prepare Tool Execution Request').first().json;

return [{
  json: {
    success:
      reservation.execution_status === 'succeeded',

    result: reservation.result,

    execution_log_id:
      reservation.execution_log_id,

    execution_status:
      reservation.execution_status,

    attempt_count:
      reservation.attempt_count,

    max_retry_attempts:
      reservation.max_retry_attempts,

    retry_limit_reached:
      Boolean(reservation.retry_limit_reached),

    session_id:
      request.session_id,

    message_id:
      request.message_id,

    safe_tool_action:
      request.safe_tool_action,

    existing_response_payload:
      reservation.existing_response_payload ?? null,

    next_action:
      reservation.execution_status === 'succeeded'
        ? 'compose_response'
        : (
            reservation.execution_status === 'running'
              ? 'wait_for_existing_execution'
              : (
                  reservation.retry_limit_reached === true
                    ? 'human_review_retry_limit_reached'
                    : 'review_or_retry_execution'
                )
          ),
  },
}];

parameters.content:
## Executor نهایی Workflow مقصد

این نسخه جایگزین Workflow 56 است.

ویژگی‌های تکمیلی:
- اجرای عمومی Endpoint ذخیره‌شده توسط Tool Router
- Idempotency بر اساس پیام، ابزار، Endpoint و Payload
- محدودیت Retry قابل تنظیم با max_retry_attempts
- جلوگیری از Endpoint نسبی ناامن و HTTP Method غیرمجاز
- ثبت نتیجه در tool_execution_logs و conversation_messages

پیش‌فرض max_retry_attempts برابر 3 است.
